author: Meltbead (https://meltbead.com/)
description: Search craft color palettes and match shades by CIEDE2000 with Meltbead.
name: Meltbead Craft Colors

tools.name: list_palettes
tools.description: List craft color palettes with counts, source links, license, and data confidence status.

tools.name: list_mard_kits
tools.description: List MARD retail box sizes and the exact bead codes included in each box; optionally select one size.

tools.name: get_color
tools.description: Look up one craft color by palette ID and product code. Accepts common code separators and Delica shorthand.

paletteId.description: Palette ID from list_palettes, such as perler or artkal-m

tools.name: search_colors
tools.description: Search codes, names, HEX values, brands, or series. Without paletteId, searches representative palettes to avoid subset duplicates.

paletteId.description: Palette ID from list_palettes, such as perler or artkal-m

tools.name: nearest_colors
tools.description: Find nearest screen reference colors in one palette by CIEDE2000 (ΔE00). Excludes effect finishes by default.

paletteId.description: Palette ID from list_palettes, such as perler or artkal-m

tools.name: match_across_palettes
tools.description: Find one approximate screen-color match per selected craft palette, starting from HEX or a product code. Uses CIEDE2000 (ΔE00).

sourcePaletteId.description: Palette ID from list_palettes, such as perler or artkal-m

items.description: Palette ID from list_palettes, such as perler or artkal-m
